heading: Ridge Bolts
narrative: - Chase - From 1 son to another, Chase takes over for his brother. He also lives in Florida. Which brother is better? I guess we will find out. Chase won the OROY (Najee Harris) award in Season 16. He is 79-73 since joining the league with 2 playoff losses. He has several achievements. MVP with QB Jalen Hurts, 3 Manager of the Year awards, Most Points in Season with Jalen Hurts, and Most Points in Game with WR Tyreek Hill. Overall, he is in 15th in wins.
